title: Symbols, Formulas and Word Equations
summary: The language of chemistry: element symbols, reading formulas like H₂O and CO₂, and writing word equations with reactants and products.

ib.note: Symbol equations and balancing follow in MYP 4 (Unit 11)

cbse.chapter: Ch 3: Atoms and Molecules (symbols, writing chemical formulas)
Ch 1: Chemical Reactions and Equations (word equations)

objectives: I can recall the symbols of common elements.
I can read a chemical formula and count the atoms of each element.
I can identify reactants and products and write word equations.
misconceptions: The small number applies to all the atoms in the formula (in CO₂ the 2 only applies to O).
A formula like CO means the same as Co (cobalt). Capital letters matter!
In an equation, the arrow means 'equals'.
